title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Wikimedia…
description: A Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Wikimedia Foundation's MediaWiki software, specifically in the MobileFrontend Extension and MinervaNeue Skin. The issue involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation in certain JavaScript resources. This vulnerability affects versions from 1.43.0 before 1.43.12, from 1.45.0 before 1.45.7, from 1.46.0 before 1.46.3, and version 1.47. The CVSS score is 4.8, indicating a medium severity risk.
